question: Which acquisition channel gives us the best 90-day retention?

candidates.reading: Cohort day-90 retention: fraction of users who signed up in a period and were active on day 90 after signup (grounding: governed metric 'active_users' joined to 'user__signup_date' and measuring activity at signup_date+90).

Cumulative 90-day retention: fraction of users who signed up in a period and had any activity within 90 days after signup (grounding: active_users by activity__active_date and user__signup_date to compute any activity in 0–90 days).

explanation: When you say "90-day retention", do you mean: (A) the share of users from a signup cohort who were active at least once between days 89–90 after signup (cohort retention at day 90), or (B) the share of users who returned at least once within 90 days after signup (cumulative 90-day retention)?
